info.title: scrapio independent collectors and tasks
info.description: O1 collectors and O2 single-stage tasks/tables/runs are mounted under /api/v4. O3 graph and O4 sources remain planned. Operations carry bounded polymorphic results; TestResult, SessionView and CollectorVersionView describe concrete projections. Real release verification pending.
